step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be a fragment of an LC tank tuning network, likely used in a Chirp-UWB VCO. It consists of NMOS transistors acting as varactors or switched capacitors to tune the oscillation frequency of the tank.

paper_reference.title: A 1mW 1Mb/s 7.75-to-8.25GHz Chirp-UWB Transceiver with Low Peak-Power Transmission and Fast Synchronization Capability

Capacitance_VL_PLUS.description: Equivalent capacitance at the positive tank node.

sky130_expected.calculation: C = C_db + C_dg for a 5u/0.5u NMOS. C_ox ~ 5fF/um^2, Area = 2.5um^2 -> C_gate ~ 12.5fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard NMOS parasitic capacitances in SKY130 for the given W/L.

Capacitance_VL_MINUS.description: Equivalent capacitance at the negative tank node.

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to VL_PLUS, but device is biased differently (G=0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the control voltage LABEL_NET_2 and the resulting channel charge.

DC_Power.description: DC power consumption of the tuning network.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = V * I. If devices are acting purely as capacitors, DC current should be minimal (leakage only).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be very low if purely capacitive, but could be higher if any device acts as an active switch to ground.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the equivalent capacitance at the tank nodes (VL_PLUS, VL_MINUS) across frequency, and checks the DC operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Varactor Testbench
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 GND N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VL_PLUS GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 GND LABEL_NET_1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N2 N5 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM6 VL_MINUS LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN4 N4 0 0
VN5 N5 0 0.9

VAC_P VL_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
VAC_M VL_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
op
let dc_current_p = -i(VAC_P)
let dc_current_m = -i(VAC_M)
let dc_power = (dc_current_p + dc_current_m) * 0.9
print dc_power

ac dec 10 1G 10G
let omega = 2 * 3.14159265359 * frequency
let c_plus = -imag(i(VAC_P)) / omega
let c_minus = -imag(i(VAC_M)) / omega

meas ac c_plus_8g find c_plus at=8G
meas ac c_minus_8g find c_minus at=8G

quit
.endc
.end
